steps: SKILL-READ SLOWNESS PROFILE (2026-06-24): ~1.5-2.5s per wkappbot skill read. TWO costs: (1) per-call FULL session-JSONL rescan in Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds -- the :-scoped cache dies PER-PROCESS (each PreToolUse spawns fresh PS so cache ALWAYS misses, rewasting 10-25s on 50-call workflows). (2) ~1.5s PS cold-start. FIX: incremental cross-process tail-read cache (persist {scannedByteOffset, lastCompactionTs, skillIds} to TEMP JSON, tail-read only new bytes). PROTO BUILT + parity-verified (wkharness-common-skillscore-proto.ps1). IMMEDIATE WIN = promote cache proto. Architectural finish = PS-floor removal.

SYSTEMIC 2-PS-STARTUP BUG (2026-06-29): wk-tool shim (.cmd) -> wkwrap.ps1 = PS startup 1. wkwrap sibling fallback L67 -> '& powershell ... -File sibling.ps1' = PS startup 2. EVERY sibling-.ps1 wk-tool pays TWO cold-starts. Measured: wkpace 2370ms median. PROPOSED FIX: change wkwrap.ps1 L67 from spawn to in-process dot-source. RISK: switch-arg binding difference (see step below).

WKWRAP DOT-SOURCE ATTEMPT + REVERT (2026-06-29, Opus, hard lesson): measured 1312ms on dot-source proto = 45% win. BUT: dot-source BREAKS switch-arg tools -- PS5.1 does not bind -Leaks/-All as [switch] params from @Rest array; binds literal '-Leaks' to next [int] positional = type error. Result: wkjobs -Leaks (agent-leak-guard) exits 0 instead of 1 = leak guard goes BLIND. VERIFIED by dispatched agent running 'wkjobs -Leaks' vs canonical. REVERTED via git checkout. ROOT LESSON: NEVER merge hot-path on reasoning alone -- run the critical switch-arg case (wkjobs -Leaks exit code) not just positional + bare calls.

CORRECT FIX (pending): (a) compiled wkwrap.exe that does 'powershell -File sibling.ps1 @args' (removes wkwrap.ps1 PS process, keeps ONE -File spawn = correct switch parsing) or (b) parse @Rest into hashtable for switch args before splatting. Both must be run-verified against 'wkjobs -Leaks' exit code before merge. Cross: verify-tool-or-guard-synthetic-live-static, wkwrap, incident-trauma-reflex-ref.
